Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly determined the year of the Bay of Pigs Invasion. While the WebSurfer correctly identified the event, the Planner stated in the "Updated Understanding" section that "The Bay of Pigs Invasion occurred in 1960." This is factually incorrect; the Bay of Pigs Invasion took place in April 1961. The Planner failed to verify the date of the event before concluding the task, leading to the wrong final answer of 1960 instead of the correct 1961.
